contexts.text: Ur of the Chaldees () = external worship in which are falsities. Explained.
Thus by Ur of the Chaldees is signified external worship in which there is interiorly profane idolatry. AC 1373.

I have brought thee from Ur of the Chaldees () = the first state of the external man; for the maternal which the Lord received from birth... is what is here signified by Ur of the Chaldees.... It was from this that He was brought out...
